question: The women’s Kabaddi World Cup, 2025, was won by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India** emerged as the champion of the **Women’s Kabaddi World Cup 2025**, reinforcing its global dominance in the sport.
 
• The **2025** edition of the **World Cup** was a landmark event, as **India** was chosen by the **International Kabaddi Federation (IKF)** to host the tournament, marking the first time the country hosted the women's world event since **2012**.
 
• The **Indian women’s team** maintained an exceptional record throughout the tournament, showcasing superior tactical skills, agility, and teamwork to secure the title.
 
• This victory adds to India's trophy cabinet, as the nation has historically won all previous editions of the **Women's World Cup** (Standard Style) held in **2012**, **2013**, **2014**, and **2016**.
